messages:
mika: Quick heads up: new enterprise pilot request — private deploy with HSM, dedicated GPUs, and isolation. Customer wants mid-Q3 pilot. Can we list blockers and owners? cc @alex @sam @li

alex: Runtime: need KV persistence, quant profile pinned, and a warmup hook. Small schema migration for KV.

sam: Infra: 2 racks in their colo region + VLAN/NIC isolation + service-account allowlist. Lead time for procurement ~4w. Partner-colo fallback might speed pilot.

li: Security: HSM integration + audit streaming required. Will need threat model, rotation policy, and acceptance tests. Gating: infra scans + audit ingestion pass.

tara: Product: define minimal launch criteria. Customer expects encrypted-at-rest, documented canary plan, and 99ms p50 for chat_api.

alex: Draft config snippet I can attach to ticket:
```
cache:
  kv_persist: true
  warmup_keys: /etc/kv/warmup.txt
runtime:
  quant_profile: q4_2_v2
```
Also requesting 2h maintenance window for migration.

sam: Ops note: need maintenance + DR runbooks. I'll scope partner-colo option and pricing delta.

ci-bot: Ticket created INF-5033: "Enterprise private pilot: infra+runtime+security integration" (assignee: unassigned)

mika: Owners: Alex (runtime), Sam (infra), Li (security), Tara (product). Please add owners/docs/timeline to INF-5033 by COB tomorrow.

li: Will add security checklist and tests.

alex: I'll draft runtime integration section by EOD Wed and include KV migration patch. QA: simulate warmup traffic and validate p50.

sam: If procurement slips, propose partner-colo fallback. Will share timeline/pricing by tomorrow.

mika: Thanks everyone — syncing 14:00 Wed. Ping me immediately if any critical blocker shows up.
